Author: Ravi Krishan Kapur

 107
12.06.2024
 Kc
 In The High Court At Calcutta

APPELLATE SIDE  W.P.A. No. 12274 of 2022  Sri Amalesh Chandra Jana  Vs.
 M/s. Indian Oil Corporation Ltd.
 (Pipeline Division) & Ors.
 Mr. Amar Nath Sen  Mr. Amit Bikram Mahata  Ms. Subhangi Panigrahi  ...for the petitioner  Ms. Sarmistha Ghosh  Mr. Victor Chatterjee  ...for the respondent nos. 1 & 2 It is fairly submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the limited prayer sought for by the petitioner pertains to compensation in respect of acquisition of petitioner's land under Section 10 of the Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962.

entities.text: Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: On behalf of the respondent an adjournment is sought for to take instructions as to the particulars in respect of the compensation paid to the petitioner.
In view of the above, let this matter appear on June 28, 2024 in order to enable the respondent to take necessary instructions.
The respondent relies on a decision of the Competent Authority viz a viz, the grievance of the petitioner.
A copy of the same be kept with the records.

(Ravi Krishan Kapur, J.)
